'''''Verbascum densiflorum''''', also known as '''denseflower mullein'''<ref>{{PLANTS|id=VEDE4|taxon=Verbascum densiflorum|accessdate=29 July 2015}}</ref> and '''dense-flowered mullein''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |access-date=2014-10-17 }}</ref> is a species of plant in the figwort family ''[[Scrophulariaceae]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Verbascum densiflorum Bertol. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:811003-1 |access-date=2023-09-26 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref>
